text:
Changed pulsar-broker/src/main/java/org/apache/pulsar/broker/service/AbstractDispatcherSingleActiveConsumer.java and wrote the reason down in docs/decisions/pulsar-handoff-consumer-race-retries.md.

Commit message:
At Brightline Rail, the load balancer's connection draining keeps the old exclusive consumer's connection half-open up to 10 s after a deploy; with 5 retries the new pod was refused and the feed stalled.

writes.docs/decisions/pulsar-handoff-consumer-r:
# Why pulsar-broker/src/main/java/org/apache/pulsar/broker/service/AbstractDispatcherSingleActiveConsumer.java holds this value

At Brightline Rail, the load balancer's connection draining keeps the old exclusive consumer's connection half-open up to 10 s after a deploy; with 5 retries the new pod was refused and the feed stalled.
